name: The Seed Bank
patron: The yard, in perpetuity, ahead of any other line.
holds: The founder populations. Six thousand four hundred species at a thousand each.
because: It produces nothing at all until the day it is needed, and on that day it cannot be started. A store that only pays out in an emergency is worthless by every measure applied before the emergency.
produces_mostly: nothing, until it is the only thing
study: Drift under storage. What a thousand founders of a given species actually keeps after fifty years in a bank rather than in a forest, which is a question nobody can answer from Earth data because nobody on Earth has needed to.
anchor: Vavilov’s collection was held through the siege of Leningrad by staff who starved beside edible seed. No milestone in that.
